battle.name: 美墨戰爭
battle.brief: 一八四六年四月得克薩斯與墨西哥在德薩爾特河開火，一八四八年《瓜達盧佩·伊達爾戈條約》割走加利福尼亞等土地。戰事自河畔打到墨西哥城，穿越高原與山嶺。卡面雷管步槍是美軍與墨西哥線列步兵的共同制式槍械，射程延長使遠距離接觸不可迴避，也改變了兩軍的隊形與射程爭論。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 交戰的兩方是美利堅合眾國與墨西哥。美國一方在總統詹姆斯·K·波爾克領導下，以「天定命運」為旗幟，軍隊由「佔領軍」擴充為正規軍、志願兵與州民兵三大塊：正規陸軍在戰前僅約八千五百人，分為五個炮兵團、一個騎兵團與十個步兵團；志願兵分為為期一年的老兵志願兵與三個月的新兵志願兵，其中紐約與新奧良的志願兵團在帕洛阿爾托與丘魯布斯科表現最為突出；民兵由各州調集，編制與裝備參差不齊，另有德克薩斯遊騎兵隊與加州民兵。戰役初期由扎卡里·泰勒的佔領軍在德薩爾特河一線作戰，一八四七年春改由溫菲爾德·斯科特接掌戰場指揮權；海軍方面，海軍上將佩里率分艦隊在韋拉克魯斯登陸並封鎖沿岸，海軍上將波特負責海上封鎖。墨西哥一方是墨西哥共和國，聖安納在戰前曾於一八四四年下台，一八四六年以「最高總統」身份重掌大權；北方軍由阿里斯塔率領，兵力約一萬五千至二萬人，西部軍由霍斯波達爾率領，另有守土民兵與各州國民軍。墨西哥軍的構成以克里奧與土著混血徵召兵為主，軍紀與訓練不如正規化的美國志願兵團，但佔有本土作戰與騎兵數量的優勢，並在韋拉克魯斯與墨西哥城周圍築有炮台與塹壕。決戰階段由聖安納親率的山地兵團與補充兵赴役，兵力在墨西哥城谷地重新集結，炮兵火力仍佔上風。
countriesEn: The two sides were the United States and Mexico. The American side, led by President James K. Polk, flew the banner of manifest destiny, and its army was built from three parts: the regulars, volunteers and state militia. The regular army numbered only about eight thousand five hundred men before the war, in five regiments of artillery, one of dragoons and ten of infantry. Volunteers were divided into one-year veterans and three-month recruits, and the volunteer regiments from New York and New Orleans distinguished themselves at Palo Alto and Churubusco. The militia was drawn from the states with widely varying organisation and equipment, and there were also the Texas Rangers and Californian militia. At first the fighting was carried by Zachary Taylor's Army of Occupation on the Rio Grande; in the spring of 1847 Winfield Scott took over field command. The navy also counted: Commodore Perry took a detachment of the squadron ashore at Veracruz and blockaded the coast, while Commodore Porter ran the maritime blockade. On the Mexican side was the Mexican Republic, with Santa Anna, who had stepped down in 1844, returning to power in 1846 as supreme president. The Army of the North under Mariano Arista numbered fifteen to twenty thousand, the Army of the West was under Hospodar, and there were local militias and state national guards for the defence of the interior. The Mexican army was composed largely of mestizo and indigenous conscripts, less well drilled and disciplined than the American volunteer regiments, but with the advantage of fighting on its own ground and in greater numbers of cavalry, and it held batteries and trenches around Veracruz and the approaches to Mexico City. In the decisive phase Santa Anna's army of the highlands came up with fresh recruits and was concentrated in the valley of Mexico, where its artillery still held the edge.
people: 美方核心是扎卡里·泰勒與溫菲爾德·斯科特兩位將帥。泰勒是經歷過第二次卡洛斯戰爭的陸軍中校，以「老粗人」著稱，他主持德薩爾特河畔的邊境部署，在帕洛阿爾托與雷薩卡以炮兵與步兵對射屢挫墨軍，但布萊恩堡一戰敗於聖安納之後，波爾克不得不改命斯科特。斯科特身材高瘦，人稱「費勁的老頭」，一八四七年三月接掌全軍，主導韋拉克魯斯登陸與數次沿國道北上，最後以丘魯布斯科、莫利諾德雷、查普特佩克三戰攻入墨西哥城；他隨軍所帶的軍醫在戰地寫下的記錄，使這場戰爭在美國本土名聲大噪。波爾克本人是關鍵人物，他主張「五萬四千或打仗」，又想以低價買下加利福尼亞，談判破裂後才授權開戰。外交上富蘭克林·皮爾斯以所謂「斜線主義」赴墨西哥談判，最終促成條約；威廉·西沃德的加入聯邦主張與約翰·弗里蒙特在索諾馬掀起的熊旗起義，把加利福尼亞的問題推向無法迴避。墨西哥方面，聖安納是全場樞紐：他在德薩爾特河劃界、召回被解職的軍人、集結全國兵力，最後自任谷地軍總司令；阿里斯塔在拉索拉達一戰陣亡後由佩德羅·阿姆普迪亞接掌北方軍，曼努埃爾·阿爾米達在莫利諾德雷陣亡，尼科拉斯·布拉沃在查普特佩克一線指揮守備，總督府與國會議事廳被攻破時，城市最終陷落；此外，墨西哥軍事學院學童在查普特佩克山頭堅守，其中胡安·德拉·巴雷拉、胡安·埃斯庫蒂亞、弗朗西斯科·馬爾克斯與阿古斯丁·梅爾加爾等人的名字在事後被記為象徵。
peopleEn: The American side turned on two commanders, Zachary Taylor and Winfield Scott. Taylor was an army lieutenant colonel who had served in the second Carlist war and was known as Old Rough and Ready; he directed the deployment on the Rio Grande and hurt the Mexicans at Palo Alto and Resaca with his artillery and infantry, but after defeat by Santa Anna at Buena Vista President Polk had to send for Scott. Scott, tall and spare and nicknamed Old Fuss and Feathers, took the whole army in March 1847, led the landing at Veracruz and the marches up the national road, and entered Mexico City after the victories of Churubusco, Molino del Rey and Chapultepec; the reports written by the army surgeon who accompanied him made the war famous at home. Polk himself was the pivotal figure: he held that the country would fight over the fifty-four forty question, yet also tried to buy California cheaply, and only authorised the war once the negotiations broke down. In diplomacy Franklin Pierce carried the supposed slanted doctrine to Mexico and brought the treaty about; William Seward's annexation speech and John Frémont's Bear Flag revolt at Sonoma made the question of California impossible to sidestep. For Mexico the pivot was Santa Anna: he drew the line on the Rio Grande, recalled discharged soldiers, mustered the country's forces and finally took command of the army in the valley himself. After Mariano Arista fell at La Soledad, Pedro Ampudia took over the Army of the North; Manuel Armida was killed at Molino del Rey; Nicolás Bravo commanded the defence around Chapultepec; and the city fell when the palace and the congress were carried. Around the hill itself the cadets of the Mexican military college held out, and the names of Juan de la Barrera, Juan Escutia, Francisco Márquez and Agustín Melgar were afterwards turned into symbols.
kits: 卡面這件雷管步槍在美墨戰爭中同時出現在兩軍的步兵序列裡，但成熟度並不相同。美國方面，一八四〇年制式的「密西西比」雷管步槍與一八四二年式步槍是政府軍的制式槍械，前者是膛線步槍，供射手與狙擊隊使用，後者是滑膛，槍重約八磅半，槍口徑點五四英吋，配刺刀使用，由常備軍與老兵志願兵團分發。墨西哥方面，北方軍的主幹仍是一八三一年式的點五四英吋滑膛燧發步槍，雷管槍只在戰爭後期少量輸入，另有卡賓槍與各式燧發手槍；墨軍的優勢在砲兵，四磅、六磅、八磅與十二磅野戰炮數量充足，另配二十四磅重砲與臼砲，用來壓制美軍的進攻線。騎兵方面，美軍的第一至第三騎兵團配馬刀、卡賓槍與燧發手槍，指揮官與德克薩斯遊騎兵還攜帶「柯特」式轉輪手槍與胡椒瓶式手槍；墨西哥的加利福尼亞槍騎兵用長矛，一八四六年十二月聖帕斯夸爾一戰中正是長矛刺傷了美軍中校凱爾尼，一方是十八世紀的冷兵器，一方是雷管火器的時代。攻城方面，斯科特投入了完整的攻城重砲隊與臼砲，韋拉克魯斯在艦炮與攻城砲的雙重射擊下淪陷。輸送與後勤是美軍的強項也是它的弱點：數千輛馬車與騾隊沿國道運輸糧彈，韋拉克魯斯以汽船接運，內陸缺水少糧的行軍造成大量非戰鬥減員。
kitsEn: The percussion rifle on this card appears in the infantry order of battle of both armies in the Mexican-American War, though at very different levels of maturity. On the American side the 1840 pattern Mississippi rifle and the 1842 pattern musket were the service arms of the government troops: the former was rifled and went to marksmen and sharpshooters, the latter was a smoothbore weighing about eight and a half pounds, of .54 calibre, fitted with a bayonet, and was issued to regulars and to the one-year volunteer regiments. On the Mexican side the backbone of the Army of the North remained the 1831 pattern .54 smoothbore flintlock musket; percussion arms arrived only late and in small numbers, alongside carbines and assorted flintlock pistols. Mexico's strength lay in its artillery, with plenty of four-, six-, eight- and twelve-pounder field guns and heavy twenty-four-pounders and mortars to cover the American approach. In cavalry the American 1st to 3rd Dragoons carried sabres, carbines and flintlock pistols, and officers and Texas Rangers were seen with Colt-pattern revolvers and pepperbox pistols; the Californio lanceros of Mexico carried the lance, and at San Pasqual in December 1846 it was a lance that wounded the American lieutenant colonel Kearny, pitting the age of cold steel against the age of the percussion cap. On the siege side Scott brought up a full heavy siege train and mortars, and Veracruz fell to naval and siege gunfire together. Transport and supply were both the American strength and its weakness: thousands of wagons and mule teams moved grain and powder along the national road, with shipping from Veracruz to feed them, and marches through a waterless interior produced heavy losses from causes other than the enemy.
tactics: 美軍的戰術主軸是「步步為營」與「正面火力加側翼奇襲」的結合。泰勒在德薩爾特河至蒙特雷一線修築一系列兵站與碉堡，使後方補給線隨前進而延伸；帕洛阿爾托一戰，他把二十四磅重砲置於中央、兩翼由第三與第五步兵團組成正面，穩住了被墨軍騎兵衝擊的陣線；雷薩卡一戰，第三騎兵團以整連衝鋒刺穿墨軍側翼。布萊恩堡一戰則相反，聖安納集中主力於高地，用數個師與三十四門砲進攻泰勒的左翼，砲火把美軍步兵壓回，裝甲薄弱的美軍步兵線一退便散，幸而德克薩斯民兵與「分鐘人」營頂住了陣腳。斯科特接手後改採迂迴：科特雷與丘魯布斯科兩役，他不碰墨軍在山間設防的強點，而以海軍陸戰隊與志願兵從樹林側翼穿插，奪取聖安納認為不可能的十字路口與磨坊，迫使墨軍連夜退往首都；莫利諾德雷一戰在缺口正面強攻，傷亡慘重；查普特佩克一戰，數個步兵團在夜裡攀上居高臨下的山脊，與守軍在陡坡上以刺刀相搏，終於奪下校場。墨西哥軍的戰術核心是依托首都外圍的梯形防禦體系：以查普特佩克的岩峰為依托，在貝倫、丘魯布斯科與莫利諾德雷一帶設堡，居高臨下用曲射炮火覆蓋通往城區的道路，試圖以守待援消耗美軍；但在正面屢遭側翼打擊、又失去制高點之後，聖安納被迫放棄被封鎖的炮台，逐次退向城牆，最後在城門洞開、總督府與國會議事廳被攻破的同時結束戰役。
tacticsEn: The American method combined a creeping fortified line of advance with frontal massed fire and flanking attacks. Taylor built a chain of blockhouse stations from the Rio Grande towards Monterrey so that his supply line followed the advance. At Palo Alto he planted his twenty-four-pounder in the centre with the 3rd and 5th infantry on either flank, and that formation held against the Mexican cavalry; at Resaca the 3rd Dragoons charged as a squadron and pierced the Mexican flank. Buena Vista went the other way: Santa Anna concentrated his army on the heights with several divisions and thirty-four guns against Taylor's left, the artillery drove the American infantry back, and the thin American line nearly broke, only the Texian troops and the Minutemen company steadying it. Scott changed the method on taking command: at Contreras and Churubusco he avoided the Mexican strongpoints in the hills and sent Marines and volunteers around through the trees to seize the crossroads and the mill that Santa Anna had thought inaccessible, forcing the Mexican army back towards the capital overnight. Molino del Rey was a frontal assault through a gap and cost heavily in blood. At Chapultepec, infantry regiments climbed the ridge in the dark and fought the defenders on the steep slope with bayonets before carrying the military school. The Mexican tactical concept was the tiered defence of the approaches to the capital: anchored on the heights of Chapultepec, with works at Belén, Churubusco and Molino del Rey whose curved fire covered the roads into the city, in the hope of wearing the Americans down while waiting for relief. Having been hit repeatedly in the flank and then deprived of the heights, Santa Anna was forced to abandon his blockaded batteries and fall back to the walls, and the war ended as the gates were forced and the palace and the congress were taken.
data: 美軍方面，戰爭爆發時常備軍約一萬二千至一萬五千人，到一八四七年高峰時在冊兵力約六萬至七萬九千人，另有民兵最高時號稱十萬；墨西哥方面，北方軍初期約一萬五千至二萬人，一八四七年春增至四萬以上，聖安納在墨西哥城谷地集結的兵力約二萬至二萬五千人。損失方面，美軍作戰與非作戰死亡合計約一萬三千人，其中陣亡約六千七百人，其餘多為疾病與事故；墨西哥方面的數字各說法相差極大，估計自兩萬五千至三萬人不等，亦有更高的說法，但缺乏可靠統計。距離方面，德薩爾特河口到墨西哥城約二千公里，韋拉克魯斯到墨西哥城沿國道約四百公里，馬車隊日行約三十至四十公里；韋拉克魯斯攻城歷時二十日，海軍封鎖期間擊毀或擄走商船數十艘。武器方面，美軍一八四二年式步槍槍重約八磅半、口徑點五四英吋，墨西哥軍主要步槍仍是一八三一年式的點五四英吋滑膛燧發槍，墨軍在布萊恩堡投入的火炮數約三十四門。
dataEn: On the American side, the army numbered some twelve to fifteen thousand men when the war began, and by the peak of 1847 the enrolled strength was about sixty to seventy-nine thousand, with militia on paper adding as many as a hundred thousand more. On the Mexican side the Army of the North began with fifteen to twenty thousand, grew past forty thousand in the spring of 1847, and Santa Anna concentrated twenty to twenty-five thousand in the valley of Mexico. In losses, American dead from battle and disease together came to about thirteen thousand, of whom roughly six thousand seven hundred were killed in action, the remainder dying of sickness and accident; Mexican figures vary enormously and are usually given as between twenty-five and thirty thousand, with higher claims and no reliable count. In distance, it is about two thousand kilometres from the mouth of the Rio Grande to Mexico City, and about four hundred kilometres along the national road from Veracruz to the capital, with wagon trains covering thirty to forty kilometres a day. The siege of Veracruz lasted twenty days, and during the blockade a number of merchant vessels were burned or taken. In weapons, the 1842 pattern musket weighed about eight and a half pounds and was of .54 calibre, while the principal Mexican musket remained the 1831 pattern .54 smoothbore flintlock; Mexico brought some thirty-four guns into action at Buena Vista.
cause: 打起來的原因分國內與國際兩層。國內層是「天定命運」的擴張信仰與選舉政治：美國在西進運動中已把加利福尼亞、俄勒岡與德克薩斯視為必然的對象，一八四四年民主黨在總統選舉中獲勝，波爾克把擴張當作政績；德克薩斯於一八四五年被吞併，使墨西哥的邊界從北緯二十六度線一下跳到北緯三十八度線，把數百萬平方公里的土地與加利福尼亞的港口一併納入共和國內，墨西哥從未承認這項吞併，邊界糾紛隨即成為最直接的導火線：一八四六年二月墨西哥軍要求美軍從德薩爾特河口撤退，三月十一日索恩頓·阿米霍的遭遇戰中雙方各有傷亡，華盛頓當局據此宣布墨西哥入侵，國會隨即授權開戰。國際層是商路與擴張的結合：通往加利福尼亞的貿易與傳教路線、聖塔菲商路與太平洋岸的港口前景，使西海岸的價值在華盛頓眼中遠高於其現有人口；國會中廢奴派與南方擴張派就加利福尼亞的歸屬互相角力，後者試圖讓新領土成為蓄奴州。墨西哥方面的起因則是國力虛弱與黨派傾軋：蒙特雷的敗績、落後的裝備、仰賴英美借款的財政，以及對北方邊界與教會權力處理的失當，種下不斷惡化的危機，終於讓墨西哥在談判與戰爭兩條路上都失去主動。
causeEn: The causes run on two levels. The domestic level was the expansionist faith of manifest destiny and the arithmetic of elections: the United States already regarded California, Oregon and Texas as its proper destiny, the Democrats won the presidency of 1844, and Polk built his administration on expansion. The annexation of Texas in 1845 moved the Mexican border in one step from the twenty-sixth parallel to the thirty-eighth, pulling several hundred thousand square kilometres and the harbours of California inside the republic, and Mexico had never recognised the annexation, so the boundary dispute became the immediate occasion. In February 1846 the Mexican army required the Americans to withdraw from the mouth of the Rio Grande, and in the Thornton-Armijo skirmish of 11 March each side lost men; Washington read the episode as Mexican aggression and Congress authorised war. The international level combined trade with expansion: the trading and mission routes towards California, the Santa Fe trail and the promise of Pacific ports made the west coast worth far more to the American planners than its few inhabitants, while in Congress abolitionists and southern expansionists fought over whether California would come in as slave territory. Mexico's own side of the story was weakness at home and factionalism: the defeat at Monterrey, outdated equipment, a treasury dependent on British and American loans, and mishandled questions of the northern border and of church power, all of which produced a crisis that kept worsening until Mexico lost the initiative both at the negotiating table and on the field.
impact: 影響遍及兩個大陸。對美國而言，戰爭一次性把國土擴大了近一半，所取得的墨西哥割讓地包括今日的加利福尼亞、內華達、猶他、新墨西哥、亞利桑那，以及科羅拉多與懷俄明的一部分，總面積約五十二萬五千平方英里；其後的舊金山淘金熱把加利福尼亞推上世界舞台，也帶來淘金時期的暴烈治理。一八五〇年妥協法案正是為消化這筆戰利品而來，其關稅與奴隸制條款直接承自墨西哥割讓地的歸屬爭議，德克薩斯的邊界也自此固定；一八五三年加茲登條約又從墨西哥買下希德哥河下游的走廊。軍隊方面，墨西哥戰爭產生大批有實戰經驗的軍官，格蘭特、謝里丹、湯瑪斯、麥克萊倫、哈佩、坎貝與布萊克都在此打響第一仗，日後美國內戰的將領班底由此成形；戰爭同時暴露了後方補給、軍醫與通訊制度的落後，促成內戰前陸軍的整頓。對墨西哥而言，這是一場塌方式的失敗：割地之外軍隊被解散，聖安納的政權在民怨中崩潰，一八四八年之後的改革派與保守派長期內鬥由此開始，最終把國家推向一八五八至六一年的改革派內戰與外國介入；而美國的示範，也讓拉丁美洲各地看見了工業化國家在技術與後勤上的優勢。
impactEn: The consequences reached both continents. For the United States the war nearly doubled the country's land area in a single stroke; the Mexican cession covered present-day California, Nevada, Utah, New Mexico and Arizona together with parts of Colorado and Wyoming, roughly five hundred and twenty-five thousand square miles in all. The gold rush that followed put California on the world stage and brought with it the rough government of a mining frontier. The Compromise of 1850 was an attempt to digest exactly this windfall, and its tariff and slave-territory clauses descended directly from the argument over the Mexican cession, which also fixed the Texan boundary. The Gadsden Purchase of 1853 bought another strip down the Gila valley. In military terms the war produced a whole generation of officers who had seen real fighting: Grant, Sheridan, Thomas, McClellan, Harney, Canby and Black all began here, and the officer corps of the American Civil War was formed out of them. At the same time the campaign exposed the weakness of the American commissariat, medical service and communications, and prompted the modernisation of the army before the war to come. For Mexico it was a collapse: beyond the territory lost, the army was disbanded and Santa Anna's regime fell amid resentment, and the long quarrel between the reform and conservative parties after 1848 grew out of it, eventually carrying the country into the reform war of 1858-61 and into foreign intervention. The American demonstration also showed the Latin American states the technical and logistic edge of an industrialising power.
result: 結果是墨西哥戰敗割地。一八四八年二月二日《瓜達盧佩·伊達爾戈條約》在墨西哥城簽訂，墨西哥放棄加利福尼亞、新墨西哥、內華達、猶他與亞利桑那北部，以格朗德河與科羅拉多河為界，賠款一千五百萬美元，美軍隨後依條款撤出。戰役層面，最後的勝負並非由一場大會戰決定：泰勒在德薩爾特河線穩住北界，斯科特則以迂迴進攻在三週之內連破丘魯布斯科、莫利諾德雷與查普特佩克；德薩爾特河畔的第一次接觸、帕洛阿爾托的炮戰、聖帕斯夸爾的長矛交鋒、韋拉克魯斯的登陸與布萊恩堡的炮戰，構成了這場戰爭不同於內戰式消耗的戰術樣本。戰後仍有尾聲：一八四七年被俘的德克薩斯遊騎兵在米耶爾堡一帶以抽籤決定生死，數百名倖存者徒步走回德克薩斯；墨西哥方面，軍隊在本土潰散，聖安納靠政治手腕保住了政權，而加利福尼亞的熊旗起義已把美軍帶進舊金山灣。最終美國得到的是土地與戰略縱深，付出的是財政透支與對外爭議的累積，這些帳目在二十年後的美國內戰中被一一重新計算。
resultEn: The result was a Mexican defeat and a Mexican cession. On 2 February 1848 the Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo was signed in Mexico City: Mexico gave up California, New Mexico, Nevada, Utah and northern Arizona, took the Rio Grande and the Colorado as its frontier, and agreed to fifteen million dollars in indemnity, and the American armies withdrew accordingly. On the field the outcome was not settled by a single general engagement: Taylor fixed the northern frontier on the Rio Grande, while Scott took Churubusco, Molino del Rey and Chapultepec in the space of three weeks by turning the Mexican position. The first contact on the Rio Grande, the artillery duel at Palo Alto, the clash of lances at San Pasqual, the landing at Veracruz and the gun battle at Buena Vista together made a set of tactical specimens quite different from the attritional style of a civil war. There were epilogues. In 1847 the Texan Rangers taken prisoner after the Mier expedition drew lots for their lives at Mier, and several hundred survivors walked back to Texas; in Mexico the army dissolved, Santa Anna saved his government by political manoeuvre, and the Bear Flag revolt in California had already carried American troops into San Francisco Bay. In the end the United States gained territory and strategic depth and paid for it in exhausted finances and a growing stock of foreign disputes, and every one of those accounts was recalculated twenty years later in the American Civil War.
